name: Red Spark
source:
Meet Joannah – a very shy girl who has just stumbled upon some truly magical powers. What will she do with her new god-like abilities? Everyone at school is about to find out...

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
认识一下乔安娜吧——这位极度害羞的女孩刚刚意外获得了神奇的魔力。拥有了这般近乎神明的力量后，她会做些什么？全校师生马上就要见识到了……

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
